---
title: "Data downloads"
---

All files are free to use. Please cite the U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey as the source and keep the `reliability_flag` with the numbers.

```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath("..")
files <- list.files(file.path(root, "site", "data"), full.names = TRUE)
info <- data.frame(file = basename(files), size_kb = round(file.size(files) / 1024))
```

| File | What it holds |
|---|---|
| [all_indicators.csv](data/all_indicators.csv) | Every indicator, county and tracts, all years, long format |
| [trends_county.csv](data/trends_county.csv) | County rows safe for trend charts (no 2020 1-year) |
| [staleness_report.csv](data/staleness_report.csv) | Legacy vintage vs newest vintage for each indicator |
| [affordability_gap_tracts.csv](data/affordability_gap_tracts.csv) | Childcare and housing affordability, one row per tract |
| [affordability_gap.geojson](data/affordability_gap.geojson) | The same, with simplified tract boundaries (EPSG:4326) |
| [childcare_facilities.geojson](data/childcare_facilities.geojson) | Facility points (**currently SAMPLE placeholder data**) |
| [municipal_boundaries.geojson](data/municipal_boundaries.geojson) | Towns and cities (TIGER/Line places), for context |

Each indicator also has its own CSV:

```{r}
ind <- info[grepl("[.]csv$", info$file) & !info$file %in% c("all_indicators.csv", "trends_county.csv", "staleness_report.csv", "affordability_gap_tracts.csv"), ]
knitr::kable(data.frame(File = sprintf("[%s](data/%s)", ind$file, ind$file), `Size (KB)` = ind$size_kb, check.names = FALSE), row.names = FALSE)
```

Column definitions and Tableau Public steps are in [docs/tableau_build.md](https://github.com/kashishchaudhari/vitalconditions-refresh/blob/main/docs/tableau_build.md).
